title: Winning the Weary Souls of the World
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner emphasizes the urgency and simplicity of winning souls for God, sharing a game-changing revelation that will transform your approach to evangelism and make it easier than ever before to bring people to Christ. Listen as Pastor Zehner breaks down the heart of God for the lost and reveals how to tap into His power to reach a weary world with the Good News of Jesus. This message will ignite your passion for soul-winning and equip you with the confidence to share the gospel with anyone, anywhere.
